items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Fillius, he’s the man, he’s the man, one of the Trustees at Hamilton.

ctx.x: So beautiful to be here, Joe.

Yeah, but you, your time up at Hamilton. That was so delicious, though. Milt, you know, Fillius, he’s the man, he’s the man, one of the Trustees at Hamilton. And he has done wonderful things, up there, to honor you. But I’ve got an idea, too. I think if Doc Cheatham would just hold on a couple more years, I think we ought to get him too.
